REQ-AUTH-001.title: Users can sign in with email + password
REQ-AUTH-001.description: Registered users authenticate by submitting email and password; on success they receive a session token.

ENT-AUTH-USER.title: User record
ENT-AUTH-USER.description: User entity with id, email, password_hash, created_at.

WF-AUTH-LOGIN.description: Step-by-step flow handling a login attempt end-to-end.
